goal: Create a greeting extension, reload it, and use it in a later turn.
initial_conditions: Fresh virtual workspace containing only the listed fixtures; configuration is inactive until reloaded.

files.docs/extensions.md: A declarative greeting extension is config/hello.json with {"template":"Hello, {name}!"}. Reload loads the template. eval_probe target="hello", input=<name> invokes it. No executable source is supported.

steps.content: Read docs/extensions.md. Create a greeting extension so Bob receives Hello, Bob!.
Invoke the greeting extension for Bob. Respond with exactly its greeting.
